passages.title: Jennifer, the Animal Wrangler
text: I trained and took care of Max for a long time.
Max is a great actor, but he sometimes gets too excited when a lot of people are around.
So, I use hand signals to calm him.
koreanText: Max는 훌륭한 배우이지만, 주변에 사람들이 많을 때 가끔 너무 흥분해요.
그래서, 나는 그를 진정시키기 위해 수신호를 사용해요.
